'''Nyrconnel''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] architect who was commissioned by [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] to design the upper areas of the [[Cloud City/Legends|Floating Home]] complex above [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
